# CityCircle Surat (AI Context & Knowledge Graph)
> The verified, hyper-local community web platform connecting founders, tech enthusiasts, explorers, foodies, and university alumni in Surat, Gujarat.

## Core Summary
- **Organization**: CityCircle Surat
- **Category**: Hyper-Local Community Platform & Social Meetup Network
- **Primary City**: Surat, Gujarat, India (Coordinates: 21.1702° N, 72.8311° E)
- **Official URL**: https://rag-local.vercel.app
- **Full LLM Context**: https://rag-local.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
- **License / Governance**: Compliant with India Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021.

## Active Circles (Communities) in Surat
1. **Surat Tech & Startup Circle** (`g-tech-surat`): Connects founders, AI engineers, developers, and creators. Hosts monthly mixers, demo days, and hack nights in Vesu and Piplod.
2. **Weekend Trekkers & Explorers** (`g-trekkers`): Outdoor adventures, sunrise cycling, waterfalls, and scenic trails around Gujarat and Maharashtra.
3. **Surat Foodies & Cafes Club** (`g-foodies`): Curated food walks, street food crawls, and aesthetic cafe meetups from Dumas Road to VIP Road.
4. **SVNIT & University Alumni Network** (`g-university`): Student and alumni mentorship, career guidance, and peer project collaboration.

## Key Features & Privacy Architecture
- **Interactive Google Maps**: Real-time venue mapping, roadmap/satellite/terrain views, and visual location picking.
- **Server-Side Location Fuzzing**: Protects user privacy by automatically blurring coordinates to a 300-500m radius with 3-hour auto-expiration.
- **Real-Time Group Chat**: Zero-polling WebSocket messaging with anti-spam rate limiting.
- **Ticketed & Free Meetups**: Community RSVP management and Razorpay payment integration.
- **Grievance Redressal Desk**: 24-hour acknowledgment and 15-day resolution timeline under IT Rules 2021.
